notes_for_editor: Status, access and history are unknown: the sources are the 2016 list, a TopoZone listing and an undated Weebly list. Not on the cached NHLR or FFLOS Georgia lists. The record's registers entries 'BLL US 41099' and 'GFC US 608' are Georgia Forestry Commission reference numbers as the 2016 list uses them (BLL-nnn = GFC-supplied coordinates; gfc-nnn = older GFC list), not national register numbers, so the registers field may need relabelling. The list's elevation column gives no unit; the record's 189.6 m assumes feet. The cached Wikipedia article on Round Oak, Georgia shows no tower. Do not confuse with the 2026 wildfire called Jones Round Oak Juliette Rd, which is unrelated.
